name: @starci/outbox
description: The Postgres job outbox of a StarCi back end in one package: a job enqueued in the caller's own transaction and kept once by its once key, a fair claim through per-(queue, scope) concurrency slots locked in one sorted order (no deadlock between claimers), leases fenced by a token every claim bumps and renewed while the handler runs, expired leases recovered, one retry ladder per class of flow, a dead letter parked with its failure class and one alert per episode, resumed by a person, a new build or the bounded sweep, scheduled starts and keyed timers, graceful shutdown, the DDL of its three tables, and a NestJS module.
author: starci183

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.d.ts'))) fs.writeFileSync('dist/' + f, fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8').replace(/((?:from |import\()['\x22]\.\.?\/[^'\x22]+)\.ts(['\x22])/g, (all, head, quote) => head + '.js' + quote))"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-exclude="src/**/*.spec.ts" --test-coverage-lines=90 "src/**/*.spec.ts"
